description: List calendar events, or assignment due dates with type=assignment, in a date range (default: the next 14 days). Read-only. Filter to specific courses with course_ids.

course_ids.description: Course IDs (numeric strings) to include. Get them from list_courses.

end_date.description: End of the range, as an ISO 8601 date or date-time, e.g. "2026-11-30".

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. Smaller is faster.

type.description: "event" (default) for calendar events, or "assignment" for assignment due dates.

name: list_calendar_events
title: List Calendar Events
